profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as providing trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates as an independent entity offering a range of products spanning clinical decision support, clinical trial management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular data management, health data analytics, and real-world evidence solutions.

Its product portfolio includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support tool aimed at providing point-of-care insights for clinicians, and Zelta, a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed for clinical trials programs. The imaging suite comprises Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, and Merge Workflow Orchestrator, while Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo serve cardiovascular service lines and were noted as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked products. Truven provides health data, analytics, and consulting services. The site cites customer outcomes including a jump from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, along with 36,000 hours in time savings and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort.

The site's held facts classify Merative under healthcare and life sciences AI, with noted capabilities in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation or regulatory filings are recorded in the available facts.
